_meta.source: Pakistani blogs, installer price lists and news reports fetched 2026-10-14 (URLs on every data point). No official/regulatory price list exists; AEDB/NEPRA publish none.
_meta.method: For each (type, kW): collect every 2026 price range found (low_rs/high_rs per source). Points flagged in excluded_points are not used (reason given). with 4+ used sources low_rs = median of their lows and high_rs = median of their highs; with 1-3 sources low_rs = lowest low and high_rs = highest high (so single-source sizes keep that source's full range); rounded to Rs 5,000; rs_per_w = that / (kW*1000). min_low_seen / max_high_seen give the full spread. A quote below low_rs is 'below typical', above high_rs 'above typical'. Sizes with no 2026 data point (6 kW on-grid, 12 kW on-grid, 20 kW hybrid) are omitted rather than interpolated. A size whose only source gives a single price (zero-width range) is excluded (see excluded_points); a size backed by one source only is kept but the engine flags it low confidence and the page says so.
_meta.notes: Sources disagree by up to 2x for the same size; most are blogs or installer marketing, several internally inconsistent (noted per source). Hybrid prices depend mainly on battery kWh/chemistry. Panel prices move 5-10% month to month with USD/PKR and tax policy (ProPakistani and Nukta reported early-2026 price rises and a proposal to raise GST on solar equipment from 10% to 18%; ProPakistani page returned HTTP 403 so it is not quoted). Business Recorder, Dawn and Express Tribune pages were not found with system-price tables in the time available. ferozepower.com figures are 2025 and were not used.
_meta.status: Secondary sources only (blogs, installer price lists); refresh monthly (Phase 6 routine). Ranges are typical installed prices incl. panels, inverter, structure, wiring, labour; hybrid ranges mix battery sizes.

includes.item: Tier-1 solar panels (N-type TOPCon 555-650 W is the 2026 norm)
On-grid or hybrid inverter (hybrid adds battery charger)
Mounting structure (galvanized/aluminium; elevated L2/L3 costs extra)
DC/AC wiring, MC4 connectors, combiner/distribution box, breakers, SPD, earthing
Net-metering paperwork / DISCO application (bi-directional meter is installed by the DISCO after approval; some sources list it as a separate Rs 15,000-30,000 line)
Hybrid only: lithium (LiFePO4) or tubular battery bank, battery cabinet/BMS, change-over switch
Usually NOT included: GST (PriceData.pk prices exclude it), civil works, long cable runs, three-phase upgrade, elevated structure
